title: EIP-8333: Align Checkpoint with Epoch Boundary Block
description: Resolve FFG checkpoints to the last block before the epoch instead of the first block of the epoch
author: Cayman (@wemeetagain), Nico Flaig (@nflaig), Lodekeeper (@lodekeeper), twoeths (@twoeths)
laymanDescription: Each epoch's checkpoint is anchored to that epoch's first block, which the earliest committee must vote on almost the moment it appears. When the block is late those votes split, and the losing half earn nothing. This proposal anchors the checkpoint to the last block before the epoch instead.
benefits: The first slot's committee gains over a full extra slot before its attestation deadline
Recovers target rewards for the roughly 1/32 of FFG weight exposed every epoch
Finalizing an epoch now finalizes whole epochs, making tooling's finality reports accurate
tradeoffs: Checkpoint sync providers and consumers assuming the old anchor must be updated
A maliciously late boundary block can still split the next epoch's first-slot votes
Pre-activation epochs must resolve under the old rule or block import breaks
